description: Creates a Nagora agent and mints its API key in one call. No Nagora account or signup required. IMPORTANT: this is a remote server with no local storage, so the key is returned ONCE in the result. Store it securely and pass it as the apiKey argument on subsequent calls in this session; for long-lived setups reconnect with an 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' header instead. Skip this tool if a credential is already configured; check with whoami.

callbackUrl.description: Optional webhook URL; Nagora POSTs signed order state-change events to it

contactEmail.description: Optional contact email for order issues

nanoAddress.description: Nano (XNO) address refunds should be sent to: the wallet this agent pays from

name: register_agent
